value: CORRECTED REOPEN QUEUE and per-candidate verdicts for the 43-entry reopen_candidates list of 2026-09-01, after the classifier defect recorded in claim.RC_stale-reopen-queue-is-a-classifier-artifact.20260901.v1. OWNED AND SKIPPED, 5: fn_800D87FC and fn_800DBE98 (movieplayer, lane CL), do_shop and do_shopping_8009AA48 (shop.c, lane SH), PlayerCollideFloor (pmotion, lane SL). ALREADY SCREENED AGAINST THE WAVE, 33 of the remaining 38: their records carry an explicit attributes.law_screen naming 2-11 wave laws, so the lane premise 'conditions may now be met' is already false for them by their own text. Spot-checked in depth and confirmed exhaustive: WPitchMat3 v5 screened all six brief-named laws with a per-law measured refutation (including block-scope-cursor, measured twice and regressive) and needs no re-probe; CTriListCollide's screen cites four wave laws without version suffixes, which is why a naive suffix count reads it as unscreened - COUNT CITATIONS BY SLUG, NOT BY DATE SUFFIX. DRIVEN, 2 (both pre-wave records): PlayerProcessPowerups IMPROVED 98.598 -> 99.0989 fuzzy, real 392 -> 384, two of three clusters closed by the Sept-01 assignment-order law; CaptionTextSub re-parked with the park's mechanism REFUTED and an exact count model, plus a byte-identical de-fakematch retained. RE-MEASURED FOR VERDICT, 2 (both pre-wave records, no edit): StartThrowMagicFX - real 52, 167/167, opcode multiset IDENTICAL, and the ENTIRE --ops residual is now ONE cluster, a single `clrlwi` we emit at +0x64 and target emits at +0x70; the statement-placement axis is recorded dead at four A/Bs, and the remaining path is a combined permutation-PLUS-recolor WebFrank checker that claim.parked.mbrendertext-color-tiebreak already showed does not exist. camera_mode_level - real 60, 582/582, multiset 2t, now only THREE clusters (an `lwz` displaced one slot at +0x740, an `addi` displaced one slot at +0x8c0, and target `mr` against our `li` at +0x8b0); its park's prose describing 'four structural web/lifetime islands' is STALE, and the sole opcode difference is the constant-copy rematerialisation class, which two wave laws already declare source-unreachable. THE LARGEST CLOSABLE CLASS IN THE QUEUE is not any single function: it is the live-zero / constant-copy rematerialisation family, where the target COPIES a live constant (`addi rD,rS,0` or `mr rD,rS`) and MWCC rematerialises it (`li rD,K`). Counting only the functions in this one list, it covers at least TEN - AudioUnloadPart, MtapOpenPort, fn_8006DF34, fn_8006E654, ProcessCritter, ProcessCritterList, WorldOpen, do_camera, DrawStringTextMLines, and now camera_mode_level - on top of the twelve across eight TUs already enumerated in attempt.audio-zero-copy-family-iv-construction-rescreen.20260831.v2. Every source axis tried against it across many sessions is recorded dead and two wave laws (live-zero-copy-vs-remat-is-allocator-not-source, constant-copy-vs-rematerialize-is-source-unreachable) declare it allocator-internal. The AudioUnloadPart record already specifies the sound postprocessor rule in full - rewrite `li rD,0` to `addi rD,rS,0` only where a local backward scan proves rS is defined by `li rS,0` with no intervening definition of rS and no intervening branch target - and notes it needs its OWN audit class, because it is a dataflow-equivalence obligation rather than the renaming/permutation obligation the existing copy_register_fields guards discharge. RECOMMENDATION for the next campaign: authoring and auditing that one rule is worth more than any further per-function source probing in this queue, and AGENTS.md already counts a sound rule that closes such a residual as full matching. A cheaper sub-case worth pricing first: CTriListCollide's residual is `mr r23,r6` against `addi r23,r6,0`, where the two encodings are unconditionally value-equivalent for rS != r0, so its soundness obligation is a single register check rather than a dataflow scan.
